claims: Assess and manage anemia with hemoglobin 7.4-9.6 g/dL and hematocrit 22-28.4%, considering transfusion given consent documented.
Monitor respiratory status and oxygenation given mechanical ventilation, variable FiO2 (50-100%), and SpO2 92-97%.
Monitor hemodynamics including low arterial blood pressure (systolic 106-152, diastolic 23-37, mean 37-60 mmHg) and consider vasopressor support.
Monitor and manage blood glucose with insulin drip and fingerstick checks given glucose 66-137 mg/dL.
Assess and manage anticoagulation with warfarin and amiodarone interaction, monitoring INR (1.1-1.2).
Monitor and manage electrolyte abnormalities including magnesium 2.3-2.8 mg/dL and potassium 3.7-4.7 mEq/L.
Assess and manage pain with multimodal analgesia (morphine, acetaminophen, ketorolac) given pain scores 2-4.
Monitor and manage acid-base status with lactate 2-2.5 mmol/L and pH 7.32-7.42.
Assess and manage nutrition given Braden nutrition score 2 (probably inadequate) and dextrose infusions.
Monitor and manage cardiac rhythm with temporary pacemaker and amiodarone infusion, given heart rate 66-73 bpm.
